label: KAMIS Open API
notes: Primary Seoul/Korea commodity source. dailyPriceByCategoryList supports Seoul code 1101 and kg conversion.

label: Japan e-Stat Retail Price Survey
notes: Monthly Tokyo retail benchmark. Retail Price Survey statistics code is 00200571; pin a real statsDataId before sync.

label: USDA MyMarketNews
notes: Wholesale/market report data. Retrieval is report/slug based, so keep an explicit report-to-ingredient mapping.

label: Eurostat Statistics API
notes: Useful for food-price indices and macro adjustment; not a restaurant supplier invoice source.

label: Mercamadrid Product Statistics
notes: Public product kilos and min/max/frequent EUR/kg prices with Excel export. No stable documented REST API verified.

label: Shanghai Government Food Price Monitoring
notes: Monthly agriculture reports and daily staple-food XLS pages. Use an explicitly pinned page/file URL; no stable public REST endpoint verified.

label: Open Food Facts Open Prices
notes: Supplemental retail observations. Coverage and joined product metadata can be sparse; preserve nulls and crowdsourced confidence.

label: Square API / Remote MCP
notes: Future merchant-owned catalog/order/inventory/labor actuals via OAuth. Keep separate from public market-price observations.
